items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And so did Willie. I mean, they all had heart trouble. So I think they all quit playing.

ctx.x: That's Willie? Yeah, that's Willie, yeah. And that's the mothers, huh? Well, let's see. Pinky died. That was the oldest brother.
And they had Johnny. He had a heart attack. And so did Willie. I mean, they all had heart trouble. So I think they all quit playing.
What did Johnny play? He played drums and trumpet. And I heard Pinky played trumpet. Yeah. And I never heard him.
